Silent no-op on any DB error (best-effort). */ export async function recordVocabReviews(userId: string, items: ReviewItem[]): Promise<void> { if (items.length === 0) return; const now = Date.now(); try { const keys = Array.from(new Set(items.map(i => i.wordKey))); const existing = await db .select({ listSlug: vocabReview.listSlug, wordKey: vocabReview.wordKey, box: vocabReview.box, correctCount: vocabReview.correctCount, wrongCount: vocabReview.wrongCount, }) .from(vocabReview) .where(and(eq(vocabReview.userId, userId), inArray(vocabReview.wordKey, keys))); const prev = new Map(existing.map(r => [`${r.listSlug}::${r.wordKey}`, r]));

records.requirementOrFinding: for (const it of items) { const p = prev.get(`${it.listSlug}::${it.wordKey}`); const box = advanceBox(p?.box ?? 1, it.correct); const correctCount = (p?.correctCount ?? 0) + (it.correct ? 1 : 0); const wrongCount = (p?.wrongCount ?? 0) + (it.correct ? 0 : 1); const nextAt = new Date(nextReviewAtMs(box, now)); await db .insert(vocabReview) .values({ userId, listSlug: it.listSlug, wordKey: it.wordKey, box, correctCount, wrongCount, lastResult: it.correct, nextReviewAt: nextAt, updatedAt: new Date(now), }) .onConflictDoUpdate({ target: [vocabReview.userId, vocabReview.listSlug, vocabReview.wordKey], set: { box, correctCount, wrongCount, lastResult: it.correct, nextReviewAt: nextAt, updatedAt: new Date(now) }, }); } } catch { // best-effort — never surface to the caller. } }

records.requirementOrFinding: /** Per-word review state for one user, scoped to a list (word keys unique there). */ export async function getVocabReviewMap(userId: string, listSlug?: string): Promise<VocabReviewMap> { const now = Date.now(); try { const rows = await db .select() .from(vocabReview) .where(listSlug ? and(eq(vocabReview.userId, userId), eq(vocabReview.listSlug, listSlug)) : eq(vocabReview.userId, userId)); const out: VocabReviewMap = {}; for (const r of rows) { const nextMs = r.nextReviewAt instanceof Date ? r.nextReviewAt.getTime() : new Date(r.nextReviewAt as unknown as string).getTime(); out[r.wordKey] = { box: clampBox(r.box), correctCount: r.correctCount, wrongCount: r.wrongCount, nextReviewAtMs: nextMs, mastered: masteredFromBox(r.box), due: nextMs <= now, }; } return out; } catch { return {}; } }

records.requirementOrFinding: /** Count of words due for review per list, for one user. Powers A3's "N due". */ export async function getDueCountByList(userId: string): Promise<Record<string, number>> { const now = new Date(); try { const rows = await db .select({ listSlug: vocabReview.listSlug, due: sql<number>`count(*)::int` }) .from(vocabReview) .where(and(eq(vocabReview.userId, userId), lte(vocabReview.nextReviewAt, now))) .groupBy(vocabReview.listSlug); const out: Record<string, number> = {}; for (const r of rows) out[r.listSlug] = r.due; return out; } catch { return {}; } }

records.requirementOrFinding: /** Per-list set of word keys the SRS considers mastered (box ≥ master box). */ export async function getReviewMasteredByList(userId: string): Promise<Record<string, Set<string>>> { try { const rows = await db .select({ listSlug: vocabReview.listSlug, wordKey: vocabReview.wordKey }) .from(vocabReview) .where(and(eq(vocabReview.userId, userId), gte(vocabReview.box, SRS_MASTER_BOX))); const out: Record<string, Set<string>> = {}; for (const r of rows) (out[r.listSlug] ??= new Set()).add(r.wordKey); return out; } catch { return {}; } }
